data.notes: April 2027 is already anchored by Shibuya’s SYNCHRONICITY/CUEW weekend, Rainbow Disco Club’s electronic pilgrimage from Tokyo, and a run of confirmed J-pop, rock, alt-pop, and VTuber arena/theater shows; most underground club calendars are not yet published this far out.

events.title: Rainbow Disco Club 2027
events.summary: Rainbow Disco Club returns to Higashi-Izu for a three-day electronic music festival weekend, with the official site listing April 16–18 operating dates and ticket categories. The venue is outside Tokyo but is a major Tokyo-scene pilgrimage reachable by direct train from Shinjuku to Izu-Inatori.

events.title: SYNCHRONICITY’27
events.summary: SYNCHRONICITY confirms its 2027 edition for April 10–11 in Shibuya, with artists to be announced later. The festival is one of Tokyo’s defining multi-venue urban music events, typically spanning indie, jazz, hip-hop, and electronic scenes.

events.title: beabadoobee: The Powerlines Tour
events.summary: Live Nation H.I.P. confirms beabadoobee’s Tokyo date for The Powerlines Tour at Toyosu PIT, advertised as her long-awaited first solo Japan performance.

events.title: SCANDAL FINAL TOUR 2026–2027 “SCANDALの47都道府県ツアー”
events.summary: SCANDAL’s 47-prefecture final tour reaches Zepp DiverCity (TOKYO) on April 30, the first of two closing Tokyo dates before the May 1 show.

events.title: Ikimonogakari — 47-Prefecture Tour Tokyo date
events.summary: Ikimonogakari’s 2026–2027 nationwide tour stops at SGC HALL ARIAKE in Tokyo, with the venue confirming an 18:00 showtime.

events.title: natori Zepp TOUR 2027 — Yokohama opening shows
events.summary: natori starts his nationwide Zepp Tour 2027 with two confirmed nights at KT Zepp Yokohama, both scheduled for 19:00 showtime.

events.title: Inui Toko 2nd Solo Live “リスタート”
events.summary: Nijisanji’s Inui Toko stages her second solo live at Tokyo Garden Theater, with guests Hoshimachi Suisei, Inami Rai, Furaka Kanato, and Kuramochi Meruto listed on the event page.

events.title: 礼賛 ONEMAN TOUR 2027 “ロワイヤル”
events.summary: Raisan’s ONEMAN TOUR 2027 “Royale” includes two confirmed Tokyo Garden Theater shows, with the April 9 performance at 19:00 and April 10 at 18:00.

events.title: CUEW Showcase & Conference 2027
events.summary: CUEW is a Shibuya-based international music showcase and conference linked with SYNCHRONICITY, aimed at connecting Japanese and overseas artists and industry delegates.

events.title: ICEx Fifth Concert Tour 2027 “NICOx LAND”
events.summary: J-pop boy group ICEx close out the April Tokyo Garden Theater run with the Tokyo stop of their Fifth Concert Tour 2027 “NICOx LAND.”

events.title: Straightener — Fictional History TOUR
events.summary: Veteran Japanese rock band Straightener brings the Fictional History TOUR to Toyosu PIT, with Hot Stuff Promotion confirming the 17:00 start time.

events.title: CUEW 2027
events.summary: Showcase-and-conference program linked with SYNCHRONICITY’27, announced by the festival for the Friday before the main Shibuya weekend.

events.title: Dizzy Sunfist “OUR DREAM IS NOT DEAD” TOUR 2027
events.summary: Osaka punk-rock trio Dizzy Sunfist play Spotify O-EAST in Shibuya on the OUR DREAM IS NOT DEAD TOUR 2027, with venue and promoter pages confirming the 19:00 start.

events.title: Reaction The Buttha 20th Anniversary ONEMAN LIVE “ブッタのゼップ”
events.summary: Reaction The Buttha marks its 20th anniversary with a one-man Zepp DiverCity concert, confirmed for a 17:00 start.

events.title: Minori Chihara Live at LINE CUBE SHIBUYA
events.summary: Voice actress and anisong singer Minori Chihara plays a full band concert at LINE CUBE SHIBUYA with Yosuke Yamamoto, Ryosuke Nikamoto, Hideki Aoyama, and Yosuke Shibasaki listed as performers.

events.title: KSCS 2027 : BACK TO TOKYO
events.summary: Breaking battle night at Shibuya HARLEM with Open Breaking 2on2, Bgirl 1on1 and Kids U15 Breaking 1on1 categories; start time, entry and judges are still TBA on the listing.
